newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria lev ends in narrower spreads to dlr/mark.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria lev ends in narrower spreads to dlr/mark.

text.p: The Bulgarian lev closed between 994.50-995.50 per mark, in a narrower spread than the morning's 990-1,000, as foreign currency supply outweighed demand on the first day of the currency board, dealers said.
* The lev was pegged at 1,000 per mark on Tuesday under the currency board, an IMF-prescribed fixed exchange rate mechanism.
* Foreign currency demand from banks and clients was very low and the central bank was seen as a main mark buyer at 995 levs, traders said.
* Traders said higher foreign currency demand in the previous days was largely speculative as long forex positions were seen higher-yielding ahead of the lev peg than lev-denominated investments.
* The lev closed at 1,735-1,737 per dollar against the opening's 1,730-1,740, tracking the domestic lev/mark rate and the mark/dollar cross on international markets.
